spans.text: Uling ding maemalen da ring Mesasanmetung a Bansa menalakaran la king karelang sariling karta king karelang kapanaligan karing karapatang pantau, king dangal a kaulagan na ning pangatau at king pante rang karapatan ning lalaki't babi at pinilmi neng teguyud ing pamanasensung pang lipunan at ing mayap a kabilyan a bie a ating malawak a karapatan.

spans.text: Kapamilatan na ning kartang iti, ding makaanib karing Mesasanmetung a Bansa pasiwala da ing karelang kapaniwalan karing karapatang pantau, king kaulagan, at ulaga ning balang tau at king pante karapatan ning lalaki't babai.

Aduan da karing sablang tau at karing anggang grupu ding lipunan a isundung pagsikapang akamtan ding kapakayan a reti kapamilatan ning pamanuru king pamangglalang karing karapatang pantau at kalayan at king kapamilatan ning pamipatibe ding batas a bibie migit a masanting a proteksyun karing karapatang kalayang iti.

spans.text: Pauli na niti, papasiwala na ning pangalaganap a kapulungan ing pamisiwala mabilug a yatu ding karapatang pantau anting metung a pangalaganap a dalerayan ning tagumpe para karing sablang tau at ding sabla nang parting pang lipunan ding memalen, a palagi rang isipan ing pamipasiwalang iti, masikap la king kapamilatan na ning pamanuru at pamagaral at aguyud da ing pamanggalang karing karapatan at kalayan a iti at kapamilatan da ring masasanting a dalerayan, pambansa at pangyatu man, tiyakan ing panglaganap at mabisang pamipaalaga at pamanupad kareti, karing memalen ding musmung kaanib a Estado at karing memalen ding teritoryung sasakupan da.
Pepasiwala na ning Panglaganap a Kapulungan ding Mesasanmetung a Bansa iting pangyatung pangalaganap a dalerayan ning tagumpe para karing sablang tau at karing sablang bansa.

spans.text: Alang ninu man ing mipailalam ya keng e makatulirang pamakialam da king kayang sarili, pamilya, bale o karing sulat o pamanamak king kayang dangal at lagyu.

entries.description: king makanyan a pamakialam o pamanamak
entries.subject: king makanyan
entries.object: pamakialam o pamanamak

spans.text: Ing balang metung ating iyang karapatan king proteksyun ning batas laban king makanyan a pamakialam o pamanamak.

folded.id: alang takut|at|alang pamikakunu king nanu mang kaburian yang dapat mag-ing peka maulaga king keka tamung kapagnasan
folded.subject: alang takut
folded.object: alang pamikakunu king nanu mang kaburian yang dapat mag-ing peka maulaga king keka tamung kapagnasan

spans.text: Ing yatu a nung nokaring ding tau atamasa ra ing karapatang magsalita nanu man ing a isip da, mamili king sarili rang kapaniwalan, at mangabiyayang alang takut at alang pamikakunu king nanu mang kaburian yang dapat mag-ing peka maulaga king keka tamung kapagnasan.

folded.id: anting metung|a|tau king arap ning batas
folded.subject: anting metung
folded.object: tau king arap ning batas

spans.text: Ing balang metung atin iyang karapatang kilalanan, nokarin man, anting metung a tau king arap ning batas.

Ing balang metung a akusadu king kasalanan a miparusan at ing karapatan ning ninu mang taung mi akusang linabag karing batas atin iyang karapatang ituring inosenti o alang sala anggang e mipatunayang mikasala agpang king batas king makalantad a pamaglitis atilu kaya ding sablang grantiyang kailangan king kayang dispensa.

folded.id: bage pamanalipa|at|pamangalakal alipan
folded.subject: bage pamanalipa
folded.object: pamangalakal alipan

spans.text: Alang ninu man ing dapat gawan alipan o busabus; makabawal la ding sablang bage pamanalipa at pamangalakal alipan.

folded.id: balang tau|at|king pante karapatan ning lalaki't babai
folded.subject: balang tau
folded.object: king pante karapatan ning lalaki't babai

spans.text: Kapamilatan na ning kartang iti, ding makaanib karing Mesasanmetung a Bansa pasiwala da ing karelang kapaniwalan karing karapatang pantau, king kaulagan, at ulaga ning balang tau at king pante karapatan ning lalaki't babai.

Aduan da karing sablang tau at karing anggang grupu ding lipunan a isundung pagsikapang akamtan ding kapakayan a reti kapamilatan ning pamanuru king pamangglalang karing karapatang pantau at kalayan at king kapamilatan ning pamipatibe ding batas a bibie migit a masanting a proteksyun karing karapatang kalayang iti.
Atin iyang karapatang lumipat ing balang metung at manuknangan kilub ning sasakupan naning balang Estado.

folded.id: bansang misasanmetung|megaku|lang misaup-saupan la king nanu mang paralan bang in karapatan at kalayan ding sablang tau keting yatu proteksyunan da at igalang
folded.subject: Bansang Misasanmetung
folded.object: lang misaup-saupan la king nanu mang paralan bang in karapatan at kalayan ding sablang tau keting yatu proteksyunan da at igalang

spans.text: Ding bansang kabilang karing Bansang Misasanmetung megaku lang misaup-saupan la king nanu mang paralan bang in karapatan at kalayan ding sablang tau keting yatu proteksyunan da at igalang.

folded.id: dapat|a|pambansang huwes agpang karing lalabag karing panimulang karapatan a ipagkalub na kaya ning konstitusyun o ning batas
folded.subject: dapat
folded.object: pambansang huwes agpang karing lalabag karing panimulang karapatan a ipagkalub na kaya ning konstitusyun o ning batas

spans.text: Ing balang metung atin iyang karapatan king mabisang atul ning karapat-dapat a pambansang huwes agpang karing lalabag karing panimulang karapatan a ipagkalub na kaya ning konstitusyun o ning batas.

folded.id: ding dakal|a|tau
folded.subject: ding dakal
folded.object: tau

spans.text: Lebagan do ring karapatang pantau ding dakal a tau.

folded.id: ding gera|at|aliwa pang kararaptanan ilang bibie pasakit karing tau agpang king istorya at king mabilug a yatu
folded.subject: Ding gera
folded.object: aliwa pang kararaptanan ilang bibie pasakit karing tau agpang king istorya at king mabilug a yatu

spans.text: Ding gera at aliwa pang kararaptanan ilang bibie pasakit karing tau agpang king istorya at king mabilug a yatu.
Uling maulagang abalu ra ding sabla ding karapatan at kalayang iti bang pilming matupad ing pangakung iti.

folded.id: ding kaanib|a|bansa mengaku la kinng makisaupan la karing misasanmetung a bansa
folded.subject: ding kaanib
folded.object: bansa mengaku la kinng makisaupan la karing Misasanmetung a Bansa

spans.text: Uling ding kaanib a bansa mengaku la kinng makisaupan la karing Misasanmetung a Bansa, a sikapan dang kamtan ing pamitaguyud king pamangalang at pamanupad ding sabla karing karapatang pantau at karing maulagang kalayan.

folded.id: hustisiya|at|kapayapan king yatu
folded.subject: hustisiya
folded.object: kapayapan king yatu

spans.text: Uling ing pamangilala king likas a karangalan at king pante at ding e alingad a karapatan ding sablang lahi ding tau iyang pundasyun na ning kalayaan, hustisiya at kapayapan king yatu.
Anggang iti e tamu aintindian, e miral ing kalayan, hustisiya at kapayapan.

folded.id: ing panglaganap|at|mabisang pamipaalaga at pamanupad kareti
folded.subject: ing panglaganap
folded.object: mabisang pamipaalaga at pamanupad kareti

spans.text: Pauli na niti, papasiwala na ning pangalaganap a kapulungan ing pamisiwala mabilug a yatu ding karapatang pantau anting metung a pangalaganap a dalerayan ning tagumpe para karing sablang tau at ding sabla nang parting pang lipunan ding memalen, a palagi rang isipan ing pamipasiwalang iti, masikap la king kapamilatan na ning pamanuru at pamagaral at aguyud da ing pamanggalang karing karapatan at kalayan a iti at kapamilatan da ring masasanting a dalerayan, pambansa at pangyatu man, tiyakan ing panglaganap at mabisang pamipaalaga at pamanupad kareti, karing memalen ding musmung kaanib a Estado at karing memalen ding teritoryung sasakupan da.

folded.id: ing yatu|a|nung nokaring ding tau atamasa ra ing karapatang magsalita nanu man ing a isip da
folded.subject: Ing yatu
folded.object: nung nokaring ding tau atamasa ra ing karapatang magsalita nanu man ing a isip da

spans.text: Ing yatu a nung nokaring ding tau atamasa ra ing karapatang magsalita nanu man ing a isip da, mamili king sarili rang kapaniwalan, at mangabiyayang alang takut at alang pamikakunu king nanu mang kaburian yang dapat mag-ing peka maulaga king keka tamung kapagnasan.
Ing karapatan a iti eya magamit nung ing pamipasakit sadya lang bunga ding pamikasalang e pulit

folded.subject: king batas
folded.object: pambansa o pangyatu

spans.text: Alang ninu mang miyatulang mikasala a nanu man pamikasala mipaparusan pauli na ning nanu mang gewa o pamangulung a e tuturing pamikasalang mipaparusan, agpang king batas a pambansa o pangyatu, inyanga awan da ita.

folded.subject: king kalupitan
folded.object: pamanapi

spans.text: Uling tune maulaga, bang ing tau e mapilitang gumerang lumaban king kalupitan at pamanapi, a ding karapatang pantau dapat proteksyunan la kapamilatan ning batas.

folded.id: king labis|a|pamipasakit o pamagmalupit
folded.subject: king labis
folded.object: pamipasakit o pamagmalupit

spans.text: Alang ninu man ing mipailalam ya king labis a pamipasakit o pamagmalupit, a e makatau mababang pamanuring o pamamarusa.

folded.id: king likas|a|karangalan at king pante at ding e alingad a karapatan ding sablang lahi ding tau iyang pundasyun na ning kalayaan
folded.subject: king likas
folded.object: karangalan at king pante at ding e alingad a karapatan ding sablang lahi ding tau iyang pundasyun na ning kalayaan

spans.text: Uling ing pamangilala king likas a karangalan at king pante at ding e alingad a karapatan ding sablang lahi ding tau iyang pundasyun na ning kalayaan, hustisiya at kapayapan king yatu.

Uling ding maemalen da ring Mesasanmetung a Bansa menalakaran la king karelang sariling karta king karelang kapanaligan karing karapatang pantau, king dangal a kaulagan na ning pangatau at king pante rang karapatan ning lalaki't babi at pinilmi neng teguyud ing pamanasensung pang lipunan at ing mayap a kabilyan a bie a ating malawak a karapatan.

folded.id: king makanyan|a|pamakialam o pamanamak
folded.subject: king makanyan
folded.object: pamakialam o pamanamak

spans.text: Ing balang metung ating iyang karapatan king proteksyun ning batas laban king makanyan a pamakialam o pamanamak.

folded.id: king pamagsalita|at|pamaniwala at kalayan king pamagnasa
folded.subject: king pamagsalita
folded.object: pamaniwala at kalayan king pamagnasa

spans.text: Uling e tamu pa maie ulaga at pamanamak karing karapatang pantau mamungang pamaglapastangan labag king konsensiya da ring sablang tau, at dasan mu rin king yatu king atamasa ring tau ing kalayan king pamagsalita at pamaniwala at kalayan king pamagnasa, pamikakunu at kasakitan a iyang papakilala nang pekamatas a kapagnasan ning karaniwang tau.

Uling ding kaanib a bansa mengaku la kinng makisaupan la karing Misasanmetung a Bansa, a sikapan dang kamtan ing pamitaguyud king pamangalang at pamanupad ding sabla karing karapatang pantau at karing maulagang kalayan.

spans.text: Balang metung atin lang lubus a pante-panteng karapatan king makatuliran at lantad a pamaglitis ning metung a malaya at alang kikilingang usgadu king pamaniguru na karing kayang karapatan at pakibatan at nanu mang dimandang kriminal laban kaya.

Ila mipagkaluban lang katuliran at konsensiya ay dapat misaupan king diwang pamikapatiran.

spans.text: Ding sabla atin lang karapatan king pante-pante laban king nanu mang pamimili a labag king Proklamasyun a iti at laban king nanu mang pamanulsul king mesabing pamamili.

folded.object: parusa kesa kanitang bibie na ning batas iniyang megawa ing pamikasalang mipaparusan

spans.text: At e dapat miparatangang mas mabayat a parusa kesa kanitang bibie na ning batas iniyang megawa ing pamikasalang mipaparusan.

folded.id: mie kalayan|at|kaligtasan antimong tau
folded.subject: mie kalayan
folded.object: kaligtasan antimong tau

spans.text: Ding balang metung atin lang karapatang mie kalayan at kaligtasan antimong tau.

spans.text: At muna kaulagang aintindian da ring sablang bansa nung nanu la ring karapatan at kalayan a reti bang atuparan la ding pangaku.

Ing balang metung atin iyang karapatan karing anggang karapatan at kalayang tikda na ning Proklamasyun a iti, king alang lalon ninu mang lahi, kule, pangatau, salita, reliyun, kapaniwalan king pulitika o aliwa pang pamaniwala penibatang bansa o lipunan, pibandian, kepaitan o aliwa pang kabilyan.
